entries.zh: 仪容、仪表；端庄得体的举止（西语 compostura 此处指仪态、体面）
entries.en: demeanour, composure of bearing; decent appearance (Sp. compostura)

entries.zh: 仪；仪容、威仪（容仪之单字）
entries.en: demeanour; dignified bearing (single character under the same Spanish headword)

entries.zh: 伶；伶俐、机敏；秀美俊俏（西注并提示参见下「伶俐」条）；兼指优伶、乐人
entries.en: clever, quick-witted (the Spanish note points forward to the compound entry); comely, well-formed; also an actor, player
entries.notes: 西注 y Leng ly 系指向「伶俐」条的互见；单字「伶」取此义属推断。

entries.zh: 伶俐；聪明机敏；利落、俏丽
entries.en: clever, quick-witted; neat, comely (Sp. compuesto, hermoso)

entries.zh: 冠冕；冠、帽（西注：闭合式帽子之类）；冕、礼冠
entries.en: crown, coronet; hat, cap (Spanish note: the closed hat, etc.)

entries.zh: 划；买（闽南方言口语用字）；兼指筹划、刻画
entries.en: to buy (colloquial Hokkien usage); the character also means to plan, to mark
entries.notes: 官话对音栏污损难辨（T99），对音与「划」字不合；释义据西、汉、闽三栏。

entries.en: to buy, to acquire; secondarily to place, to set

entries.zh: 零买小件杂物；字头存疑（捘/拣），或兼指拣选
entries.en: to buy small items (Sp. comprar cosas pequeñas); headword uncertain, if 拣 then also to pick out, to select
entries.notes: 汉字栏存疑（捘/拣），且闽、官两栏音节数不齐，取西注义。
西语词头栏空缺，据「贸」字与两栏对音推断，未经西栏互证。

entries.zh: 籴；籴粮、整批大宗买入（西注 compr. avult.＝成批大量购买）
entries.en: to buy grain in quantity; to buy in bulk, in gross (Sp. comprar avult[adamiente])
entries.notes: 西注 avult. 为缩写，按文义展开为 avultadamente（大量地）。

entries.zh: 备办；置办、采办所需物品
entries.en: to provide, to procure, to get in what is necessary (Sp. comprar lo necessario)
entries.notes: [疑] 仅属字形异写（僃＝備），两读词义无别。

entries.en: to buy in addition, to purchase to make up what one lacks (Sp. comprar para alcançe)
entries.notes: 西注 paraq alance 为缩略残句，展开为 para alcançe 属推断。

entries.zh: 坐货；据西注：买下合伙人的货本份额，余货另行分出
entries.en: to buy out a partner's share of the merchandise, the remainder to be set apart (per the Spanish gloss)
entries.notes: 「坐货」词义无法独立确证，释义据西栏；西栏句末 tras- 截断（跨页）。

entries.zh: 主顾；老主顾、常客（习惯性惠买之人）
entries.en: customer, patron; one who buys habitually (Sp. comprar de ordinación)

entries.zh: 主客；宾主；客（自外方来买货之人）——西栏文句残损，确义存疑
entries.en: host and guest; a guest, visiting buyer (Spanish gloss garbled)
entries.notes: 西注文句残损不成句，「主客」与西注对应不明，语义无法定夺。

entries.en: to buy jointly, to purchase together (Sp. comprar por juntos)
